entries.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
entries.text: Processing of digital personal data needs a lawful purpose, notice and consent. Collect only data necessary for the stated purpose, keep it only as long as needed, apply reasonable security safeguards, report personal data breaches, and let individuals access, correct and erase their data. Extra care applies to children's data.
entries.control: Record consent and purpose, minimise collected fields, define retention and deletion schedules, mask personal data in logs and exports, support access/correction/erasure requests, and maintain a breach-response procedure.

required_controls.name: Consent and notice
required_controls.suggested: The system shall record each member's consent and the purpose for which personal data is collected, and display a privacy notice at registration.

required_controls.name: Retention and deletion
required_controls.suggested: The system shall retain borrowing history only for the institution-approved retention period and then delete or anonymise it.

required_controls.name: Data-subject rights
required_controls.suggested: The system shall let members request access to, correction of, or erasure of their personal data, with each request logged.

entries.title: Information Technology Act, 2000 and institutional IT security policy
entries.source: Government of India / University IT policy
entries.text: Unauthorised access to computer systems and data is an offence. Institutions are expected to apply reasonable security practices, restrict access by role, encrypt sensitive data and report cyber security incidents as required.
entries.control: Role-based access control, encryption in transit and at rest, access logging, and an incident-reporting procedure.

required_controls.name: Role-based access control
required_controls.suggested: The system shall enforce role-based access control so each staff and member role can access only the functions and data it needs.

required_controls.name: Encryption
required_controls.suggested: The system shall encrypt personal and transaction data in transit and at rest.

entries.title: Application security controls (OWASP ASVS / ISO 27001 aligned)
entries.text: Applications should use strong authentication, secure session management, input validation, least privilege, secure logging and protection of APIs against injection.
entries.control: Single sign-on or multi-factor authentication for staff, session timeout, input validation and secure API design.

required_controls.name: Strong authentication
required_controls.suggested: The system shall authenticate staff and members through the university single sign-on, with multi-factor authentication for administrators.

entries.title: Copyright Act, 1957 and publisher licence terms for e-resources
entries.text: Use of e-journals, e-books and databases is limited by licence: only authorised users, simultaneous-user limits, download and print limits, and no systematic bulk downloading. Remote access must be through authentication.
entries.control: Authenticate users, enforce simultaneous-user and download limits per licence, detect bulk downloading and keep usage statistics.

required_controls.name: Licence-limit enforcement
required_controls.suggested: The system shall enforce each e-resource licence's simultaneous-user and download limits and block bulk downloading.

required_controls.name: Usage statistics
required_controls.suggested: The system shall record e-resource usage statistics per resource and academic year for licence renewal and reporting.

entries.title: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and WCAG 2.1 AA
entries.text: Public-facing ICT services should be accessible to persons with disabilities. Web interfaces should conform to WCAG 2.1 level AA: screen-reader support, keyboard navigation, text alternatives, sufficient contrast and accessible document formats.
entries.control: Design and test to WCAG 2.1 AA, including screen-reader and keyboard-only testing.

required_controls.name: Accessibility conformance
required_controls.suggested: The system's web interface shall conform to WCAG 2.1 level AA and be usable with a screen reader and keyboard alone.

entries.title: Institutional repository and open-access policy (UGC ETD regulations)
entries.text: Theses and dissertations are deposited electronically in the institutional repository and the national ETD repository as required. Institutional policy defines embargo periods, access levels and licences for deposited work.
entries.control: Deposit workflow with supervisor approval, embargo handling, plagiarism-check record and licence capture.

required_controls.name: Embargo handling
required_controls.suggested: The system shall support embargo periods on deposited theses and release them automatically on the approved date.

required_controls.name: Descriptive metadata
required_controls.suggested: The system shall capture Dublin Core metadata for every deposited item.

entries.title: Accreditation and ranking data requirements (NAAC / NBA / NIRF)
entries.text: Library data such as holdings, expenditure on books and journals, e-resource subscriptions, usage statistics and footfall must be reportable by academic year with supporting evidence.
entries.control: Scheduled and on-demand reports by academic year with CSV/PDF export and source-record drill-down.

required_controls.name: Evidence export
required_controls.suggested: The system shall export accreditation reports by academic year in CSV and PDF with drill-down to source records.

entries.title: Cataloguing and metadata standards: MARC 21 and Dublin Core
entries.text: Bibliographic records follow MARC 21 for catalogues and Dublin Core for repositories, enabling import, export and exchange with other systems.
entries.control: Validate records against MARC 21 / Dublin Core on import and export.

entries.title: Circulation interoperability standards: SIP2 and NCIP (ANSI/NISO Z39.83)
entries.text: Self-check kiosks, RFID gates and external circulation systems communicate with the library system through SIP2 or NCIP.
entries.control: Interface conformance tests and fallback behaviour when the integrated system is unavailable.

entries.title: OAI-PMH 2.0 for repository metadata harvesting
entries.text: Repositories expose metadata through OAI-PMH so national repositories and discovery services can harvest them.
entries.control: Expose an OAI-PMH endpoint and test with a harvester.

entries.title: Institutional lending and fines policy (placeholder)
entries.text: Loan periods, borrowing limits and fine rates are set per member category by the library committee. Any fine waiver or block override needs an authorised librarian and a recorded reason.
entries.control: Policy parameters configurable per member category; overrides authorised and logged with reason.

required_controls.name: Configurable policy parameters
required_controls.suggested: The system shall let an authorised administrator configure loan period, borrowing limit and fine rate per member category.

entries.title: Institutional records retention and audit policy (placeholder)
entries.text: Transaction and audit records are retained for the institution-defined period, are tamper-evident and are backed up with a tested recovery procedure.
entries.control: Immutable audit log, scheduled backups and tested recovery.

required_controls.name: Backup and recovery
required_controls.suggested: The system shall back up data daily and support recovery within the institution-approved RTO and RPO.
